app.title: Outpatient intake
app.description: Patient registration for the outpatient department, with a live view for reception staff.

home.heading: Outpatient intake
home.patientBlurb: Fill in your details while you wait
home.staffBlurb: See who is filling in a form right now

patient.title: Register at reception
patient.intro: Fill this in while you wait. You do not need to finish it before someone calls you.
patient.ticketHint: Reception can see this number. Say it if you need help before you finish.
patient.privacy: A member of staff can see this form as you fill it in, so they can help if you get stuck. Nothing is shared outside the hospital.
patient.nationalityNoMatch: No match — tell reception and they will add it

submitted.heading: Your details are with reception
submitted.body: Please take a seat. A member of staff will call your name.
submitted.correction: If something was wrong, tell the person at the counter — they can see what you sent and correct it for you.

connection.body: Keep filling in the form — what you have typed is safe and will be sent as soon as the connection is back.

preferredLanguage.label: Preferred language
preferredLanguage.hint: The language you would like staff to speak with you

validation.futureDate: Date of birth cannot be in the future
validation.tooLongAgo: Check the year — that is over {years} years ago
validation.phone: Check the phone number for that country

staff.title: Reception — live intake
staff.stuckAnnouncement: {count, plural, =0 {No patients need help.} one {# patient needs help.} other {# patients need help.}}
staff.emptyHeading: Nobody is filling in a form
staff.emptyBody: Sessions appear here the moment a patient opens the form. Hand out the counter tablet or point them at the QR code.
staff.listReconnecting: Reconnecting. This list may be out of date.
staff.listOffline: Disconnected. This list is frozen and not updating.
staff.needFixing: {count, plural, one {# needs fixing} other {# need fixing}}
staff.chooseHeading: Choose a patient to watch their form
staff.chooseBody: Anyone marked <idle>Idle</idle> has stopped partway through and may be stuck. Start there.

detail.notFocused: Not on any field right now
detail.endedBody: It was submitted a while ago or the patient left without finishing.
